prompt.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: opaque square fantasy MMORPG inventory item icon. Paint in World of ClaudeCraft woc-item-icon-v1 style. Single shield shown complete from the front with slight three-quarter depth, centered occupying 72 percent of square, generous safe padding all around. Premium hand-painted classic dark fantasy MMO artwork, tactile metal and wood, crisp focal edges and softer peripheral brushwork. Warm top-left key light, cool deep bottom-right shadows. Fully opaque deep charcoal painted vignette with restrained zone tint and subtle contact shadow. Readable silhouette at 22px and circular crop. No text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, logo, watermark, border, UI, rarity frame, hands, person, environment scene, collage, or transparent background. Output one square image at least 1024x1024. The previously viewed Eastbrook Buckler, Kingsbane Last Oath and Linen Pouch are house-style references only, not subject identities. Primary request: Lychgate Buckler, a modest uncommon early adventurer shield rewarded by a chapel priest for laying restless dead to rest in Eastbrook Vale. Round stout dark weathered oak buckler with aged silver iron rim, eight broad rivets, dull iron central boss, two broad iron reinforcing bands, restrained aged ivory paint worn from the oak. Simple sturdy chapel-yard equipment, no skulls or magic, no emblems. Warm umber charcoal ground. Distinct round silhouette.

framingEditPrompt: Edit only composition and framing. Preserve this exact shield design, materials, colors, light and painterly style, but zoom out so the complete shield is centered and its height spans exactly 72 percent of the square image, leaving 14 percent empty painted background above its top and 14 percent below its bottom. Generous background margin on every side. Continue the same subtle dark painted background seamlessly, no frame or border. Do not redesign or add objects or writing. Opaque square output.
